critique: The render has a strong Wild World-like look: dense magenta particle ribbons on black, broad organic wave arcs, bright tangled foreground filaments, and visible evolution between frames 1 and 4 rather than a static pattern. However, the field is excessively displaced/cropped at the frame edges and reads more like an enlarged partial section of the world than a balanced preset composition. The extremely large Kaleidospace center value is the most likely cause of the unstable framing and oversized off-screen geometry.

suggestions.why: The current Kaleidospace center is orders of magnitude outside the composition/particle-space scale (-307200, -97200, 97200), likely from an incorrect coordinate conversion. Restoring it to the corresponding unscaled 3D coordinates should bring the distortion back into the visible world and reduce the severe edge cropping.
